name: esp32_dac_oneshot
description: dac/dac_oneshot on the ESP32: each DAC steps its code by 10 every 500 ms (DAC2 half a second behind), VDD3P3_RTC x code / 255 on its pad, and ADC2 (channels 8 and 9, GPIO25 and GPIO26, 12 dB) reads the pads every 100 ms. With this chip's Vref (1170 mV) ADC2's fitted line is a = 56320, b = 128 mV: code 10 (129.4 mV) reads 2, 20 reads 152, 30 reads 303, 40 reads 453, 50 (647.1 mV) reads 604. The example prints with a bare \n.

expect.contains: DAC channel 0 value:    2	DAC channel 1 value:    0
DAC channel 0 value:  152	DAC channel 1 value:    2
DAC channel 0 value:  453	DAC channel 1 value:  303
DAC channel 0 value:  604	DAC channel 1 value:  453
